title: 2023 Panini Select Football Premier DJ Johnson #143 RC Silver Prizm Die Cut
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2023 Panini Select Football Premier trading card features DJ Johnson of the Carolina Panthers. The card is made of high-quality card stock with a thickness of 35 Pt. It is an original silver prizm insert set with a parallel/variety of DJ Johnson's rookie card. The card is from the National Football League (NFL) and is licensed by Panini. It is a standard-sized card and is not autographed. The card number is 143, and it was manufactured in the United States in 2023. This card is a must-have for any football fan or collector.
